extName.description: Extension name. Follows Google's required third-party naming format, [Feature] for [Product]™ — the name must not lead with the YouTube trademark.

extDescription.message: Auto-fits the YouTube player to your window, screen and playback quality. 4K and multi-monitor aware, with a pop-out player.
extDescription.description: Chrome Web Store listing description, 132 character limit.

qualityHint.message: Every new video locks to this quality. If the video does not offer it, the highest available is used instead.

modeAutoDesc.message: Caps at the video's native resolution, then shrinks to fit the window

modeFitDesc.message: Always uses all available window space, whatever the quality

displayAwareQuality.message: Raise quality to match the screen

displayHint.message: Derives the quality it needs from player width x pixel density. It only upscales past the video's native resolution when the video has nothing better to offer. Setting a preferred quality above overrides this.

popupFollow.message: The screen the window is on

removeSideGaps.message: Remove the gaps beside the player

resizeMainWindow.message: Resize the browser window to match
